# `unhex`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
unhex(expr)
```

Converts hexadecimal `expr` to binary.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |

| Deterministic | yes |
